description:
On the Moon, on Mars, and in deep space, dozens of craft now lie silent: probes that have completed their missions, immobilized rovers, spent rocket stages, defunct satellites, and pieces of equipment left behind. Some were abandoned, while others simply stopped responding. Yet, each one has a story to tell, and they continue to provide us with new insights.
We want to share their stories in an educational and engaging way, tailored for school-aged space enthusiasts.
summary: SPACE LEGACY is a web app that turns NASA’s space history into stories young people can feel. Many children and teenagers around the world, whatever their background, grow up far from space. Some are drawn to it, but it feels complicated and out of reach, so it stays distant. We want to bring it closer. Pick a machine left on the Moon, on Mars, or in deep space, and SPACE LEGACY creates a personalized video, article, or quiz about its journey, its discoveries, and its final chapter, adapted to your age and curiosity. What makes it different is trust: every story is generated only from a structured database of NASA data and automatically fact-checked, so the AI tells the story without inventing anything. Our goal is to spark wonder, understanding, and future space careers, while letting curious users go straight to the original NASA sources.
details:
What It Does & How It Works

Space Legacy builds a personalized story from verified NASA data about a machine left in space. The user chooses a spacecraft, enters their age, and states what they want to know. The platform then executes a five-step pipeline:

  1. Data Extraction & Structuring: NASA data is extracted, cleaned, cataloged, and referenced, then stored in a PostgreSQL database.
  2. Media & Data Retrieval: The API retrieves every item linked to the chosen machine, including texts, images, and videos.
  3. Core Story Assembly: A Large Language Model (LLM) assembles these retrieved items into a cohesive core narrative linked to its corresponding media assets.
  4. Automated Fact Verification: A Python verification script checks that every factual element of the core story exists in the database, ensuring that no information comes from the model alone.
  5. Age & Tone Adaptation:The verified core story is adapted to the user's age, preferred tone, and specific questions. An AI video model generates a tailored video from this verified story, alongside customized articles and interactive quizzes.

Users can open the original NASA sources directly from the platform to verify facts or explore further.

Benefits and Intended Impact

Space Legacy aims to make space feel close and accessible to young people who often perceive it as out of reach. The intended impact includes:

  • Sparking Curiosity: Helping young audiences understand how spacecraft work and why their missions matter.
  • Inspiring Future Careers: Encouraging interest in space science, robotics, and aerospace engineering.
  • Active Learning: Reinforcing comprehension through interactive quizzes tailored to the story.
  • Preserving Engineering Heritage: Giving a lasting voice to forgotten spacecraft by connecting their technical design to the scientific breakthroughs they enabled.
  • Cross-Generational Engagement: Rekindling interest among adults while providing a direct bridge to primary NASA documentation for fact-checking.

Tools, Coding Languages, Hardware, or Software Used

  • Runtime & Language: Node.js, TypeScript
  • API & Validation: Hono, Zod, @hono/zod-openapi
  • Database & ORM: PostgreSQL 16, Prisma
  • Caching & Rate Limiting: Redis 7
  • AI & Fact-Checking Pipeline: Large Language Model (LLM) for story assembly, Python script for automated database fact-verification, AI Video Generation model
  • Frontend & Administration: Web User Interface (React / Vite / Tailwind CSS), Static HTML Admin Dashboard
  • Security & Logging: Argon2, jose (JWT), sanitize-html, Pino (structured JSON logs)
  • Infrastructure, Testing & Tooling: Vercel, Docker Compose, pnpm, Vitest, ESLint, Prettier

Creativity


The core innovation of Space Legacy is a constrained storytelling architecture: an AI narrator strictly limited to facts found in our curated NASA database, enforced by an automated verification script. Key creative features include:

  • Narrative Over Fact Sheets: Each machine's journey, discoveries, and final chapter are told as a story rather than a static list of specifications.
  • Emotional Connection: Stories are crafted to build empathy and closeness with the machines, not merely to deliver raw facts.
  • Dynamic Personalization: A single machine generates completely different content, vocabulary, and depth depending on the user's age, tone, and curiosity.
  • Bridge to Primary Sources: Every narrative links directly to NASA's original documents so users can verify facts and explore further.


Factors Considered by the Team

Four key factors shaped the design and architecture of Space Legacy:

  • Scientific Accuracy: All generated content is grounded in NASA data and cross-checked against our database. We transparently communicate that content is AI-assisted and provide direct source links rather than presenting it as infallible.
  • Age Adaptation: The primary target audience is children aged 6 to 14, with deeper technical layers for teenagers aged 14 to 18 and source-rich exploration for adults.
  • Emotional Resonance: Stories are written to make users feel connected to the spacecraft and the human ingenuity behind them.
  • Transparency: The platform clearly discloses to users that stories, videos, and quizzes are generated by AI from verified NASA archives.

The link of project : https://github.com/Padevend/Space-Legacy-Apps
